sentences.text: She has also deposed that on 08-06-2019 accused issued a legal notice to her calling upon her to join him.
During her cross examination she deposed that she and her husband lived happily only for 3 months.

She admits that she has not mentioned about the accused asking her get additional dowry of Rs.4,00,000/-
in her complaint.
She also admits that the statements given by her at para 2 of her chief examination are not mentioned in her complaint.
She admits that she had not stated in her complaint that accused did not provide her food.
She also admits that she has not mentioned about her mother in law giving her life threat in her complaint.
She identifies the reply notice given by her through her counsel as Ex-D1.
She admits that soon after her marriage the accused had vacated their tenant and given the same home to her in order to stay with the Accused No.1.
She admits that she had not stated in Ex-D1 that the accused had demanded 4 lakhs dowry soon after marriage.
She admits that before filing of this complaint her husband had filed petition for restitution of conjugal rights before the family court.
She admits that she had filed petition in Crl.Misc No.14/2020 under Domestic Violence Act as per Ex-D5  8  C.C.No.14092/2020 and 6.
She admits that earlier she had given a complaint before Mahalakshmipuram P.S but even in the said complaint she had not told about the accused demanding Rs.4,00,000/- additional dowry.
She admits that she and the accused have compromised in M.C.No.4086/2020 and as per the compromise they have divorced.
She also admits that they have mutually agreed to withdraw this case.

The accused No.1 is the husband of CW-1.
In her chief examination she has supported the evidence of PW-1.

During her cross examination,
she has admitted that accused and CW-1 have taken divorce.
She has stated that she does not know anything about this case personally.
12.CW-8 was examined as PW-3.
He deposed in his examination-in-chief that he signed on Ex.P.2 spot mahazar as per ExP.2(b).
He further deposed that police did not conduct any mahazar in his presence and the police.
On going through the evidence of Pws.1 and 2, it can be seen that they have deposed identically.
During the cross examination PW-1 admits that she had never stated about additional dowry, life threat and other incidents in her complaint which she has deposed during her chief examination.
This shows the CW-1 has made improvements to her case.
Same improvements can be seen in the evidence of PW-2.
This show that they both are interested witnesses.
Hence, the improved version of PW 1 and 2 cannot be looked into.
It is fundamental principle of law that any improvements made in the case cannot be looked into.

7  14.
During the cross examination it has come on record that this case was filed after the accused had issued legal notice calling upon the complainant to join his company.

This show that there was a vengeance against accused and his family and the fact that in order to take revenge against the accused and his family, this case is being filed cannot be completely ruled out.
Further, the PW- 1 and 2 being sisters trying to implicate the accused and his family members in this case also cannot be ruled out.
PW 1 has admitted that they have mutually got divorce and she has taken back all her allegations.
PW-2 during her cross examination admits that she does not have any personal knowledge of disputes between accused No.1 and his sister.
Such being the case, the entire evidence of PW 1 and 2 cannot be relied upon.
Hence, this court hold that prosecution has failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
